items.q: How much does Lafala ERP cost?
items.a: Priced by company size and deployment. After a 30-minute demo we'll give you a concrete proposal. No tier menu.
The demo uses our sample data. If you send over a sample of yours, we'll preload it so the demo runs on your real scenarios.
One Docker Compose command. Typically a 4-core 8GB Linux server — enough for a custom-furniture shop for over a year.

items.q: Can I import data from Excel?
items.a: Yes. We provide Excel templates for customers, products, and quotes, and help with initial migration.
Three months of free white-glove onboarding (remote training plus a WeChat support group). After that, an annual fee covers upgrades and remote support.
